resume:
Mobile App Developer (Android & iOS) with 2+ years of experience building and publishing apps on Google Play and the App Store, including apps used by millions. Experienced in Native Android (Java/Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) with ~1 year of developing personal projects, plus professional Flutter/Dart; strong in REST APIs, offline storage, push notifications, and performance optimization.
EDUCATION
Fitchburg State University
Master’s in Computer Science  Jan 2025 – Dec 2026(Exp.)
GPA: 3.83/4.0; Coursework: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Algorithms, Operating Systems
Nepal College of Information Technology (Pokhara University)  2017-2022
B.E. in Information Technology Engineering | Native Android(Java|Kotlin) and iOS(Swift) coursework projects

WORK EXPERIENCE
NSDevil Co., Ltd.  May 2024 – Jul 2024
Mobile App Developer  Lalitpur, Nepal
Korea-based EdTech company behind UBT Cloud, the platform used for EPS-TOPIK Korean-language exams.
Built the Flutter exam-monitoring client that integrates with UBT Cloud's existing AI proctoring and verification services, enabling remote TOPIK exams with camera-based supervision and anti-fraud checks.
Engineered an in-app support flow chatbot that enabled test-takers to troubleshoot issues directly within the exam platform, enhancing user communication and problem resolution.
Tech Stack: Flutter, Dart, REST APIs, DIO, Postman
Merojob Pvt. Ltd.  Jul 2023 – Apr 2024
Mobile App Developer  Kathmandu, Nepal
Company behind Nepal's leading online recruitment portal, Merojob, connecting job seekers with employers across the country.
Built the Employer and Job-Seeker Flutter apps for Android and iOS with Riverpod, Firebase, and REST APIs; delivered full Nepali localization of blue-collar job listings, opening the platform to job seekers who can’t read English,broadening the platform's reach, plus offline caching, push notifications, and Sentry monitoring.
Tech Stack: Flutter, Dart, Bloc, Riverpod, Firebase Cloud Messaging, Sentry, Agile
Hamro Patro Inc.  Mar 2022 – Mar 2023
Mobile App Developer  Kathmandu, Nepal
Company behind HamroPatro, Nepal's widely used app combining calendar, news, radio, and financial services, with 10M users.
Designed and built a real-time GPS school-bus tracking feature from scratch, streaming live locations over gRPC and rendering routes with the Google Maps API so parents can follow every trip; this achievement facilitated my promotion from Intern to Associate.
Built Hamro Health features for the 10M-user app, including video/audio consultations with livekit, e-prescriptions, and a care-team app, using Riverpod and Firebase, significantly reducing the need for in-person hospital visits.
Tech Stack: Flutter, Dart, gRPC, Google Maps API, Shared Preferences, Riverpod, Firebase, Hive, DIO, LiveKit, SQLite
SKILLS
AI & Data: LLM API Integration (OpenAI), Prompt Design and Evaluation, NLP, scikit-learn, pandas
Languages: Dart, Java, Kotlin, Python, C/C++, SQL, Swift
Mobile: Flutter, Android SDK (Java/Kotlin), Riverpod, Bloc, Firebase,FCM, Deep Linking, Play Console/App Store Deployment, Jetpack Compose, Gradle configurations, Offline storage(SQLite/Hive), iOS(Swift)
APIs, Data & Tools: REST APIs, gRPC, Shared Preferences, MySQL, Git/GitHub, Codemagic CI/CD, Sentry, Postman, Jira
Soft Skills: Debugging, Problem-Solving, Cross-Team Collaboration, Written & Verbal Communication, Agile
PROJECTS
Resume ↔ JD Matcher |Flutter, FastAPI, OpenAI API, Riverpod  2026
Built an AI-powered Flutter app end to end that scores resume-to-job-description fit and returns matched/missing skills; moved OpenAI calls behind a FastAPI backend so the API key never ships in the client, used Riverpod for state, and tuned prompts to counter AI over-flattery.
Employ Nepal|  Android, Java, Firebase
Built a native Android job app: job seekers search and apply for part-time jobs; employers post openings.
Certifications: Programming in Java & Android App Development (Broadway Infosys); Supervised Machine Learning; Advanced Learning Algorithms (DeepLearning.AI)
job_description:
Full job description
We are looking for an existing Full Stack Developer - AI Trainer to help train AI models. You'll be part of a growing community of over 100,000 professionals — including front-end, back-end, full-stack, machine learning, and other engineers — who are driving real-world impact in AI development.

Our platform offers an engaging blend of flexibility and challenge: you'll work closely with state-of-the-art AI models to take on programming tasks that include creating and solving challenging coding problems, building beautiful apps with rich functionality, and synthesizing insights through data analysis and visualization. Your work directly contributes to refining intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and evolve. You can fit this work alongside a full-time role, or treat it as your primary focus, choosing projects and schedules that align with your availability and goals.

To get started, once you sign up for an account, you'll take a short assessment (this serves as our version of an interview). If you pass that assessment, you'll receive an email confirmation, and paid work will become available to you through our platform.

Advantages of contracting with us:

Fully remote: work from anywhere in the US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.
Flexible schedule: choose which projects you take on and when you work, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home.
Competitive pay: projects are paid hourly at $50 to $100 USD per hour. Opportunities for higher bonus rates available for certain projects.
Impact: help shape the future of AI technologies.
Responsibilities:

Design and solve diverse coding problems used to train AI systems.
Write clear, high-quality code snippets and detailed explanations.
Evaluate AI-generated code for accuracy, performance, and clarity.
Provide feedback that directly shapes the next generation of AI models.
Qualifications:

Fluency in English (native or bilingual level).
Proficiency in at least one of the following programming languages or frameworks: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C, C#, C++, React, Go, Java, Kotlin, or Swift.
Excellent writing and grammar skills.
A bachelor's degree (completed or in progress).
Previous experience as a Software Developer, Coder, Software Engineer, or Programmer is preferred.
Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. This job is only available to those in the US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand. Those located outside of these countries will not see work or assessments available on our site at this time.
